verdict.rationale: Outlook's automations are Inbox rules that apps can create through Microsoft Graph, so this axis applies to the product. Nothing in the evidence shows version history, change review, or rollback for those rules. The community remark about rolling back systems refers to uninstalling the new Outlook client, not reverting automations, so it does not count.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
